start_here: Say to your AI: "Open my article first." It runs tool:read-a-published-article with slug first and shows its sections, sources and the course it points to.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads one published row of the articles table and the course it names, and changes nothing.
instructions: 1. Name the pursuit database that holds the rows, such as example_for_who_uses_it; the computer opens it with the read login its vault holds.
2. Say what you want in plain words; your AI calls tools:run with tool tool:read-a-published-article and the input.
3. Read the answer: the one article, or article null for a draft or unknown slug. Show it with the screen the tool names.

worked_examples.title: Open one article
worked_examples.given: The database holds the rows the read names (made-up values).
